scripts.postinstall: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:python
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "node scripts/serve-frontend.js"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:hot: concurrently -n api,web,warmup -c magenta,cyan,gray "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "node scripts/warmup.js"
